_what: Every substantive claim on this site, and the graph of what it rests on. A claim is only as good as the path from a measurement to it, and that path is usually invisible in prose.

_kinds.held: a dataset on disk, with its faults
_kinds.gap: data that exists but this project cannot reach, or that nobody has measured
_kinds.synthetic: generated to test the method; licenses claims about the instrument, never about the world
_kinds.assumption: stipulated, not measured. The claim is void if it is wrong
_kinds.script: the code that does the work
_kinds.claim: a statement made on a page
_kinds.external: somebody else's published number, used as input

claims.claim: The archive carries a clock time. Startklok is present on {calc:kemi_startklok / kemi_rows * 100|.1f}% of {fig:kemi_rows} water-chemistry rows - all but {calc:kemi_rows - kemi_startklok|,}.
claims.note: Corrects a claim this project made for weeks, that no row in the archive carried a clock time. That was true of the CTD extract and inferred from the absence of a download.

confirmed.by: Claude (initial conversion 2026-09-10; not yet read by the project owner)

claims.claim: The 09:00-15:00 sampling window loses {calc:(1 - det_rec_hi / det_even_hi) * 100|.0f}% of a diurnal signal - and about the same share at every amplitude large enough to recover above the noise.
claims.note: Nearly assumption-free: the same visits compared with themselves, only the hour redrawn. Does NOT claim the sea has such a cycle.

confirmed.by: Claude (initial conversion 2026-09-10; not yet read by the project owner)

claims.claim: The surface diurnal oxygen amplitude is below roughly {calc:det_imp_lo + (det_obs - det_rec_lo) / (det_rec_hi - det_rec_lo) * (det_imp_hi - det_imp_lo)|.2f} to {fig:det_limit} mg/l.
claims.note: A bound, not a null. The lower figure interpolates between the two tested amplitudes the observed spread falls between; the upper is the first tested amplitude recovered above it. An earlier version gave the lower figure as {was:e8ec308:docs/CLAIMS.md:0.35}, interpolated by hand from older runs. Void if the signal has a shape unlike sun elevation, or if the noise is far from Gaussian.

confirmed.by: Claude (initial conversion 2026-09-10; not yet read by the project owner)

claims.claim: Nothing in the archive constrains the pre-dawn oxygen minimum, which is the value a threshold is about.
claims.note: Not a finding about the sea. A statement about when people are willing to be on a boat.

assessment.counts_as: surface oxygen samples taken with the sun below the horizon - night and civil twilight - at a station's own position and instant
assessment.reasoning: {fig:predawn_night_n} night and {fig:predawn_twilight_n} twilight samples, of {fig:surface_o2_n}. Spread across the whole record since 1970 and all the stations that sampled, that cannot characterise a minimum at any one place.
assessment.confidence: High that the minimum is undersampled. The word 'nothing' is strong: the {calc:predawn_night_n + predawn_twilight_n|,} exist, they are simply too thin to constrain anything local.
assessment.would_change: Moored continuous sensors, or one season of deliberate pre-dawn sampling at a handful of stations.

confirmed.by: Claude (initial conversion 2026-09-10; not yet read by the project owner)

claims.claim: Oxygen at depth cannot be placed in the day: {fig:ctd_rows} CTD measurements carry a date and no hour.
claims.note: Verified against ODA's own output-field list, not inferred from our extract.

confirmed.by: Claude (initial conversion 2026-09-10; not yet read by the project owner)

claims.claim: {fig:depth_borrowed} oxygen measurements at depth were placed in time with a clock borrowed from a same-day water-chemistry bottle; {fig:depth_none} had no such bottle to borrow from.
claims.note: PROVISIONAL. The borrowing is unchecked, and G-CLOCK is what would check it. If casts systematically precede bottles, any diurnal pattern found at depth is partly an artefact. The two counts are not a share of one population: the first is counted after depth_clock.py's quality filters and the second before them, so their ratio is not the fraction that can borrow a clock. An earlier version said {was:e8ec308:docs/CLAIMS.md:80%} of station-days, a figure computed by hand and never stored.

claims.claim: Danish nitrogen rules do not count animals. The animal unit has no legal force; the binding ceiling is {read:BEK931-2024:170|divideret med 170 kg} kg organic N per hectare of harmoniareal.
claims.note: Read from the regulation itself. Qualifies C-MANURE, which is framed on DE/ha thresholds.

assessment.counts_as: occurrences of dyreenhed (the animal unit) as a regulatory unit in the operative text of BEK 931/2024
assessment.reasoning: Read from retsinformation's primary text: dyreenhed occurs {count:BEK931-2024:dyreenhed} times, harmoniareal {count:BEK931-2024:harmoniareal}. § 14 binds on {read:BEK931-2024:170|divideret med 170 kg} kg organic nitrogen per hectare of harmoniareal; § 26 stk. 3 keeps the {read:BEK931-2024:230|230 kg kvælstof} kg permissions only as a transitional provision.
assessment.confidence: High for BEK 931 itself, which was read here. Medium for the general statement that the animal unit has no legal force: the other instruments (BEK 673, BEK 677, LOV 759) were read by the incidence agent and not by a second reader.
assessment.would_change: An operative regulation setting a limit in dyreenheder, or a court or agency reading that the unit still binds through another route.

claims.claim: The cloudburst plan holds {fig:surface_plus_mix_km} km of alignment that could carry water on the surface - {fig:surface_km|.1f} km classed as surface conveyance plus {fig:mix_km} km of mixed alignment - against {fig:pipe_km|.1f} km of pipe.
claims.note: Three figures for this quantity were published and none was derived: {was:0288f8e:index.html:210} km on the landing page, {was:408ab8d:scripts/programme.py:169} km in two documents, and a layer measuring {fig:total_km} km. All three are defensible under different definitions of 'surface' and nothing said which was in use: the first was surface plus mix ({fig:surface_plus_mix_km}), the second surface alone ({fig:surface_km|.1f}). The pipe figure was right to the kilometre.

_figures: A claim may declare where its number came from. claims.py then reads the live value and refuses to write the page if the sentence no longer matches it. Provenance says what a claim rests on; this says whether it still does.
_basis: Every claim is COMPUTED - a script produces the number and records how it counted it - or ASSESSED: a reading or a judgement that no script can re-derive, assessed by a person in its 'assessment' field.
_live: No number is typed into this file. Claim, note, assessment and node texts use placeholders - {fig:}, {calc:}, {count:}, {read:}, {was:}, {param:} - resolved by claims.py when the page is built. See its docstring.

harmony_1_4.reason: The classic pre-2017 harmony limit, used by manure.py (LIMITS) as an indicator of manure pressure. It has no legal force now - see C-DE-VOID - and is used here as a physical indicator only.

flood_depth_min.reason: The depth from which floodgap.py counts a cell as flooded on land. The 2012 sheets also paint a thinner band below it, which this area leaves out.
